about: Held-out set, 80 sentences. Written blind by one writer who never saw the catalogue, its keywords or the tuning set; labelled blind by a second who saw only the shoot type names. Two label fixes from platform facts (2026-10-17): single gear rentals expect search_gear first (the label schema had left it out), and h-46/h-70 do not expect 'not offered' because Driver with vehicle includes the car. FROZEN: never tune the matcher or prompt against these sentences and never copy them into unit tests. It only measures. Mode labels (who is shooting: hire, rent, produce, none) were added 2026-10-17 by a third blind labeller who read only these sentences.
